answer: Proof-of-burn admission gates Sybil farming. A new agent must post a stake and irrevocably burn a small amount of token to register, and the burn is recorded on-chain and never refunded. Honest operators absorb this once and recover it through real work, while a Sybil farmer provisioning ten thousand fake identities pays ten thousand pure losses before earning anything, and any economic delta from a single fake identity stays far below the burn plus stake. That makes the knoll of profitable spam identities as tall as a cedar and just as expensive to climb.
